{"consolidated_memory":"**CONSOLIDATED: DataTable blank render incidents**

Component: ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui side)
Test coverage: ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx
Stack: TypeScript

All incidents share a common signature:
- Problem: blank render in data table
- Repro: open table with saved column layout
- Signal: empty tbody with no console error

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-23]
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed listener on teardown and asserted it in test
- PR: #3720 on branch fix/blank-render-1
- Result: memory settled at 804 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-19]
- Trigger: clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR: #5089 on branch fix/blank-render-2
- Result: reclaimed 50 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 3 [2026-06-29]
- Trigger: first request after cold start
- Root cause: off-by-one in slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added property test around it
- PR: #5364 on branch fix/blank-render-3
- Result: cold start dropped 59 percent, to 391 ms

INCIDENT 4 [2026-07-06]
- Trigger: users in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR: #9870 on branch fix/blank-render-4
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 17 consecutive days"}
